artists.source_line: Kizz-N Organisation has the right to update the Festival.

features.rationale: The venue listing states there are three big rooms, so more than one dance floor.
The Saturday and Sunday programme lists daytime socials from 16:00.
The festival advertises 35 hours of workshops as part of the event.
Masterclasses are listed as a bookable ticket option.
The venue section lists taxi teams, meaning taxi dancers are present.
A main booking hotel with a discount code is recommended, while accommodation is not part of the pass.
A transfer section gives airport and station transport information relative to the venue, but no shuttle service is explicitly stated.
